pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: My bike was stolen!
paragraphs: Fictional bike report: blue frame, black basket, yellow sticker. Last seen at the station rack at 6 pm. Report made; serial number can be provided privately to the relevant desk. The lesson does not require a real theft or real identifying information.

pages.title: Make a clear report

pages.title: A similar bike has been found
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. There’s an update about the bicycle report. A blue bike with a black basket has been found near the station. The yellow sticker hasn’t been confirmed, and the serial number hasn’t been checked yet. It may be the missing bike, but it hasn’t been identified as yours. Reception will contact you when the identifying details have been compared. Could you tell the other person what has actually been confirmed, and what you still need to ask?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. There’s an update about the bicycle report. A blue bike with a black basket has been found near the station.
